 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # The colored panel is the bounding rectangle of its background color 1.
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 1]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in cells)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in cells)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)
    h, w = r1 - r0 + 1, c1 - c0 + 1
    out = [[0] * h for _ in range(w)]
    # Reflect the panel across its anti-diagonal (swapping the dimensions).
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            out[w - 1 - c][h - 1 - r] = grid[r0 + r][c0 + c]
    return out
